title: Private Kelowna Sailing Cruise on Okanagan Lake
includes: all safety equipment provided, blankets, drinking water
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Guests must be able to board sailboat, and be comfortable on a moving boat
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Sailing is a quiet, peaceful experience, as the boat is powered by nothing but the wind. 

You are welcome to sit back and relax, enjoy the sights, or take a turn at the helm, with instruction from your skipper!

I will never forget the first time I sailed, and hope to create the same memory for my guests.
